description:
Should someone buy this home or keep renting? Runs the TerraVue engine: a
    deterministic 30-year simulation plus a 500-scenario Monte Carlo over correlated
    market paths. Returns the probability buying wins, the breakeven hold period, and
    net-worth outcomes.

    monthly_rent = what the person would pay to rent THE SAME HOME to live in — an
    owner-occupant buy-vs-rent decision, NOT rental income they'd collect as a landlord
    (this tool does not model rental cash flow; that lens lives on terravue.app). A rent
    far out of line with home_price is almost certainly a misunderstanding — confirm it
    before trusting the verdict. If `address` is given, the ZIP's real appreciation forecast
    and regional tax/insurance defaults are used (explicit parameters still win).

address.description: Full US street address, or a bare 5-digit ZIP. Pass it whenever it is known: it grounds property tax, insurance and the appreciation forecast in that ZIP's real figures instead of national defaults.
address.title: Address

analysis_years.description: Hold period in years. Use the horizon the person actually stated — if they say 'about five years', pass 5. Only default to 30 when no horizon was given.
analysis_years.title: Analysis Years

down_payment_pct.description: Down payment as a PERCENT of price: 20 means 20%. Not a fraction (not 0.20).
down_payment_pct.title: Down Payment Pct

fixed_rate.description: Mortgage interest rate as an annual PERCENT: 6.75 means 6.75%. Not a decimal (not 0.0675).
fixed_rate.title: Fixed Rate

hoa_monthly.description: HOA or condo fee in US dollars per month. 0 for most single-family homes.
hoa_monthly.title: Hoa Monthly

home_appreciation_rate.description: Annual home appreciation as a PERCENT: 3.5 means 3.5%/yr. Prefer leaving this unset and passing `address` instead, so the ZIP's FHFA-derived forecast is used rather than a guess.
home_appreciation_rate.title: Home Appreciation Rate

home_price.description: Purchase price in whole US dollars, e.g. 650000 (not 650 or 650k).
home_price.title: Home Price

investment_return_rate.description: Annual return the renter earns on invested cash, as a PERCENT: 9.5 means 9.5%/yr, roughly long-run equities. This assumption drives the result more than any other — drop it to about 4.5 if the alternative is savings rather than the market, or if the person sounds risk-averse, and present both runs.
investment_return_rate.title: Investment Return Rate

monthly_rent.description: What this person would pay per month, in US dollars, to rent THE SAME HOME to live in. This is an owner-occupant comparison — it is NOT rental income they would collect as a landlord.
monthly_rent.title: Monthly Rent

property_tax_rate.description: Annual property tax as a PERCENT of home value: 0.55 means 0.55%/yr. Leave unset to use the ZIP's real rate when `address` is given.
property_tax_rate.title: Property Tax Rate

name: buy_vs_rent
